work: Misevic, Ofria & Lenski 2006, Proc R Soc B 273:457-464
why_it_matters: The only clean variation-operator ON/OFF ablation found in any domain, combined with a longitudinal exhaustive one-mutant detector, both arms, 100+100 replicates with SEM, and an orthogonal probe satisfying F. It is HC-T01's design two decades earlier. Its missing cell is the SAME cell HC-T01 failed to fill.
status: FULL TEXT READ (PMC HTML; publisher PDF bot-walled)

missing: C_MECHANISM (clean on/off; has a rate parameter instead)
why_it_matters: Supplies every cell Misevic lacks, including a WITHIN-RUN PRECURSOR observation and an acquisition outcome ('lineage lag', time-to-re-adapt after an environment switch) that AVOIDS the ceiling-coupling hazard that made HC-T01's K7 unwinnable. Its reciprocal mutation-rate transplant is a textbook F control.
status: FULL TEXT READ (PMC HTML + bioRxiv v2 PDF)

work: Rutten, Hogeweg & Beslon 2019, BMC Evol Biol 19:191
why_it_matters: Two million offspring generated with the exact evolutionary operator, at two lineage time points, with TWO independent F controls including a native-mutator arm.
Cleanest offspring-cloud instrument in evolutionary robotics with a five-way representation comparison and a predictive link to damage recovery, but the signature is taken at generation 8,000 only.

work: Yu & Miller 2001 (EuroGP LNCS 2038:204-217) and Yu & Miller 2002 (EuroGP LNCS 2278:13-25)
why_it_matters: Both abstracts assert a mutation-spectrum measurement made DURING evolution under an explicit-neutrality representation, which would be A+B+C. 2001 abstract: 'we introduce the use of explicit neutrality with an integer string coding scheme to allow neutrality to be measured during evolution'. If they also contrast neutral against non-neutral representations they would be the earliest instance of A+B+C. THEY WOULD STILL ALMOST CERTAINLY LACK D, whose outcome in that literature is success rate.
status: NOT RETRIEVED. Author tree www.cs.mun.ca/~tinayu/ returns 403 for everything; Springer, ResearchGate, Unpaywall, S2 and OpenAlex all closed. THE LARGEST REMAINING RESIDUAL RISK IN THIS PASS.

why_it_matters: C-shaped by its abstract ('the role of mutation and genotype length in the evolvability of the representation'); detector unknown. Scored UNKNOWN rather than from memory.
